messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High request spike detected for /v1/embeddings (model: embed-large) — sustained 6k rps, error rate 8% on prod-region-1. Alerting oncall. See /incidents/1823456789 for playbook.
oncall-sre: i'm taking this. oncall here: @kai can you pull top IPs + API keys? i'll start triage.
kai: grabbing flow logs now. looks like ~85% of traffic is from a handful of rotating IPs, same API key pattern: ak_live_XXXXXXX. user agent is weird: "okhttp/3.12.1" repeated with different accept-language headers.
maya: runtime metrics — queue depth on embed nodes spiked, CPU pinned, p50 latency x3, autoscaler struggling to keep up. we have some 502s from worker OOM.
sam: support — any customer-facing errors reported yet? i can open status once we know impact.
oncall-sre: impact: ~12% of customer requests seeing 5xx or timeouts, mostly small customers hitting public API. high risk to cost and quota exhaustion. start mitigations now.
leah: product — recommend temporary stricter throttles on public tier, and disable the batch/async embedding endpoint for non-enterprise keys. agree?
oncall-sre: agree. plan: 1) apply emergency per-key rate limit 15 rps for public keys 2) throttle long-request token >512 to 5rps 3) disable batch embeddings endpoint for non-dedicated accounts 4) add a WAF rule to block the suspicious UA pattern 5) notify support and customers. we'll re-evaluate in 1h.
kai: prepared admin API calls. snippet:
```
# set per-key throttle
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/quotas \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"target":"key:public","limit_rps":15}'

# disable batch endpoint for tier=free,standard
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/feature-flags \
  -d '{"feature":"batch_embed","state":"off","scope":"non-enterprise"}'
```
oncall-sre: executing now.
incident-bot: change applied: quota update id=chg_7f3b, feature-flag change id=ff_229, propagation to edge in ~20s.
ops-bot: WAF rule deployed (id=waf_331). blocking UA regex: /okhttp\/3\\.12\\.1/ and ASN list: [suspect-asn-1,suspect-asn-2].
maya: after changes — traffic dropped ~60% to embed nodes, error rate down to 1.8%, latency returning toward baseline. CPU still elevated but autoscaler catching up.
sam: posting status: "Degraded — spike in bot traffic affecting public embeddings. Mitigations applied; we are investigating."
leah: notify account managers for any enterprise customers in affected regions; give proactive outreach if they saw failures.
oncall-sre: gathering additional for postmortem: top 10 API keys, top 50 IPs, UA patterns, payload size distribution. kai please attach pcap/export to the incident channel.
kai: exported logs to /tmp/incident-1823456789-traffic-export.tar.gz and uploaded to secure file share. also included request sample payloads and token distribution histogram.
oncall-sre: handoff to night oncall @nk in 20m. nk please monitor traffic for reappearance and rollback rules if we see false positives.
nk (eng-sre-night): ack — i'll take over at 03:40 UTC. if traffic resumes, plan B is to escalate to targeted key revocation (for keys with >500rps) and enable stricter global throttle 5rps.
leah: product note — prioritize short-term: block/ratelimit abusive keys and UA; medium-term: add adaptive burst control per-key + token-cost caps in billing system.
oncall-sre: final note before handoff: keep batch endpoint disabled for 1h; will reconvene for uplift meeting and P1 postmortem doc. tagging compliance if any data exfil concern arises.
sam: support update queued — sent to status page and opened a customer message template for affected customers.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded to P2. next update in 30m or on call handoff.
nk (eng-sre-night): taking over. will watch dashboards and escalate if error rate >3% or rps >1.5x baseline.
leah: thx team. we'll assemble RCA and mitigation playbook entries tomorrow. :thumbsup:
